idea_model.decision: Adopt for the virtual release and an observe-only field pilot.
idea_model.user_decision: The shift supervisor can keep a particle alert open after CO₂ falls or reopen it on rebound. A technician selects an inspection only with equipment evidence, while administrators activate profiles and the bridge reads its sensor.
idea_model.documented_need: The Korean November 2025 inspection and HSE commissioning guidance establish the need for site-specific verification. Measured ORNL supply-air data provides separate equipment context.
idea_model.alternative: An incumbent building-management system with synchronized pollutant measurements and a maintenance log can support the same decision. Independent permissions, common resource provenance, two vendor adapters and configured profile reuse justify integration across organizations.
idea_model.acceptance: Three adequate-airflow trials distinguish recovery, persistent particles and rebound. Open field test: compare unassisted setup, correct shift handoff, lookup time and technician findings against the incumbent using identical calibrated readings and site-approved intervals. Physical ventilation or exposure benefit remains unverified.
